_comment: Humanoid Body Type 2 skeleton joint map. One of two parametric base bodies the player creator surfaces as 'Body Type 1 / 2'. The canvas substrate every damned soul (player + NPCs + larvae) is built from -- see docs/design/character-canvas.md. Rigify-Tweaked deform-bone naming: every joint prefixed DEF-, .L/.R for sides. hips=DEF-spine (root), DEF-spine.003 is the chest where shoulders attach, DEF-spine.005 is the head. Bendy splits (DEF-thigh.L.001, DEF-shin.L.001, etc.) are mid-segment deformers; semantic-role mapping uses the upper-segment primary. Joint names are identical to humanoid_male (same rig topology); only rest-pose proportions differ.
_lockon_note: Skeleton-level fallback. Per-archetype overrides (e.g. larva) will author their own list once the rig is in use.
